# Asteroid Orbit

A simple HTML‑canvas game where the player controls a ship orbiting a planet. Asteroids drift inward; the ship can rotate around the planet and thrust outward to dodge and collect fuel pickups. The game ends (lose) when the ship collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.
